title: Intrinsic system proper/open restriction is exchange followed by inverse unit
statement: For a commutative square k:A→B, r:A→C, p:B→D, i:C→D with quasi-compact open immersions k,i and proper r,p, let o be the actual unbounded strict-system operations, c their normalized compositors, and a their open comparisons. For every unbounded system M on A, the prescribed lambda homomorphism P_i R_p J_k M→R_r M equals the proper exchange P_i R_p J_k M→R_r P_k J_k M followed by R_r of the inverse open unit M≅P_k J_k M. No Cartesian, boundedness, constructibility or tensor hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0F7B, restriction calculation for proper/open interchange; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 07A7, adjunction mates and composition

proof.text: Factor k and r through the canonical clopen lift s into B times_D C. Associativity of the normalized system pullback compositors factors the inverse-image square into the Cartesian square followed by restriction along s. Take proper mates and use the iterated-mate/conjugate identity and beta_transpose to identify the Cartesian factor with cartesianConjugate. The inverse k-open unit, transported through the open compositor, is restrictFactor followed by the inverse s-open unit. Its proper transpose is a.clopen by clopen_transpose. The remaining proper compositor and equality transport are exactly the final factors in properOpenLambda. This argument uses only units, counits and their triangle identities in the unbounded system categories, before evaluation.
